name: O-1 Extraordinary Ability Visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a US employer or a US agent as petitioner — genuine self-petition is not possible, even though the standard is individual extraordinary ability.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a petitioning US employer or authorized agent.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires demonstrated extraordinary ability in sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics, or extraordinary achievement in motion picture/television.

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years initial, 1-year extensions with no statutory maximum

notes: Uncapped — no annual numerical limit and no lottery, a genuine structural advantage over us_h1b. Frequently used as a bridge to us_eb1's EB-1A category, since both share an overlapping 'extraordinary ability' evidentiary standard, though EB-1A permits genuine self-petition where O-1 requires an employer/agent petitioner throughout. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months left null since O-1 itself doesn't lead anywhere directly — the holder must separately qualify for an immigrant category (typically EB-1A).
